leaks_secret.instructions: This code writes a secret value (a password, API key, access token, private key or session cookie) into a log line, console output, an error or exception message, or a URL.

criteria.true: A variable or field whose name or origin shows it holds a secret is interpolated, concatenated or passed into a log call, console output, an error message, or a URL or query string.
criteria.false: Secrets are only sent in request headers or bodies, or are masked or redacted before being written, or the code handles no secrets at all.
